text.en:
The following provincial roads in the province of Iloilo are converted into and declared as
national roads:
a) Concepcion-San Dionisio Road
b) Ajuy-Fuente Bunglas-Jamulawon Road
c) Passi-San Enrique-Garita Road

Any provision of law, decree, order, rule or regulation inconsistent with this Act is repealed or
modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 7, 1983
